URBAN DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT

NOTIFICATION

Shimla-2, the 10th March, 2026

No. UD-A(1)-1/2025.—WHEREAS, a proposal for declaration of Nagar Panchayat Bir,
District Kangra as notified vide this Department Notification No. UD-A(1)-1/2025, dated
11-11-2025 was published in the Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal Pradesh on 13-11-2025 for
inviting objections from the affected persons through the Deputy Commissioner, Kangra within a
period of two weeks;

AND WHEREAS, the objections received from the inhabitants of the local areas proposed to
be included in Nagar Panchayat Bir, District Kangra, within the prescribed time limit, during the
personal hearing, were duly considered and finally decided by the Competent Authority vide order
dated 10-03-2026 in accordance with law;

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (2) of Section (3)
and sub-section (6) of Section 4 of the Himachal Pradesh Municipal Act, 1994 (State Act No. 13
of 1994), the Governor, Himachal Pradesh is pleased to constitute Nagar Panchayat Bir District
Kangra, Himachal Pradesh as per the area specified in THE SCHEDULE attached with this
notification and it shall come into existence from the date of its publication in the Rajpatra

The Governor, Himachal Pradesh, further in exercise of the powers conferred by
sub-section (7) of Section 4 read with sub-section (1) of Section 80 of the Act ibid; is pleased to
exempt the land and buildings of the said Nagar Panchayat from the payment of property tax for
a period of three years from the commencement of this notification. The residents of said areas
shall continue to retain their customary rights as provided in Wazib-Ul-Urj of the records of rights.

By order,

DEVESH KUMAR,
Pr. Secretary (UD).

URBAN DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
NOTIFICATIO N
Shimla-2, the 10th March, 2026

No. UD-A(1)-4/2016.—WHEREAS, a proposal for inclusion of some areas in Nagar
Panchayat, Narkanda, District Shimla was notified in accordance with the provisions of
sub-section (1) of Section 5 of Himachal Pradesh Municipal Act, 1994 (State Act. No. 13 of
1994) for inviting objections from the inhabitant(s)/person(s) likely to be affected thereby, vide
this Department Notification No. UD-A(1)-4/2016, dated 07-08-2025 and published in Rajpatra
(e- Gazette), Himachal Pradesh on 11-08-2025;

AND WHEREAS, the objections received from the inhabitants of the local areas proposed to
be included in Nagar Panchayat, Narkanda, District Shimla, within the prescribed time limit,
during the personal hearing, were duly considered and finally decided by the Competent Authority
vide order dated 10-03-2026 in accordance with law;

NOW, THEREFORE, the Governor, Himachal Pradesh, in exercise of the powers under
sub-section (3) of Section 5 of the Himachal Pradesh Municipal Act, 1994 ( State Act No. 13 of
1994), is pleased to include the areas specified in THE SCHEDULE attached with this notification,
in the Nagar Panchayat, Narkanda, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh from the date of publication
of this notification in Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal Pradesh.

The Governor, Himachal Pradesh further in exercise of the powers conferred by
sub-section (4) of Section 5 read with sub-section (1) of Section 80 of the Act ibid is pleased to
exempt the land and buildings in the areas specified in THE SCHEDULE from payment of

property tax for a period of 03 years from the date of publication of this notification in the
Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal Pradesh. The residents of these areas shall continue to retain their
customary rights as provided in Wazib-Ul-Urj of the record of rights.

By order,

Sd/-
(DEVESH KUMAR ),
Pr. Secretary (UD).

MEDICAL EDUCATION & RESEARCH DEPARTMENT

NOTIFICATION

Shimla-2, the, 10th March, 2026

Comp. No. 132404.—The Governor, Himachal Pradesh, is pleased to order the creation
of 02 (two) posts of Assistant Professor in the Department of Hospital Administration at IGMC
Shimla, in the public interest, with immediate effect.

This issues with the prior approval of the competent authority.

By order,

Secretary (Health).

[Authoritative English text of this Department Notification No. UD-A(1)-3/2022-Part-1
dated 10-03-2026 as required under clause (3) of Article 348 of the Constitution of India].

URBAN DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT

NOTIFICATION

Shimla-171 002, the 10th March, 2026

No. UD-A(1)-3/2022-Part-1.—WHEREAS, proposals for inclusion of certain areas in
Municipal Corporation Una, District Una, Himachal Pradesh were notified in accordance with the
provisions of sub-section (3) of Section 3 of the Himachal Pradesh Municipal Corporation Act,
1994 (State Act No. 12 of 1994) for inviting objections from the inhabitant(s)/person(s) likely to be
affected thereby, vide this Department’s Notifications No. UD-A(1)-3/2022-Part-1 dated
20-06-2025, published in the Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal Pradesh on 21-06-2025, and No. UD-
A(1)-3/2022-Part-1-Loose, dated 13-11-2025, published in the Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal
Pradesh on 15-11-2025;

AND WHEREAS, the objections received from the inhabitants of the local areas proposed to
be included in Municipal Corporation Una, District Una, within the prescribed time limit, during
the personal hearing, were duly considered and finally decided by the Competent Authority vide
order dated 10-03-2026 in accordance with law;

NOW THEREFORE, the Governor, Himachal Pradesh, in exercise of the powers under
sub-section (3) of Section 3 of the Himachal Pradesh Municipal Corporation Act, 1994 (State Act
No. 12 of 1994), is pleased to include the areas specified in THE SCHEDULE attached with this
notification, in the Municipal Corporation Una, District Una, Himachal Pradesh from the date of
publication of this notification in Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal Pradesh.

The Governor Himachal Pradesh further in exercise of the powers conferred by
sub-section (4) of section 3 read with and sub-section (1) of section 143 of Act ibid is pleased to
exempt the land and buildings in the areas specified in THE SCHEDULE from payment of
property tax for a period three years from the date of publication of this notification in the
Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal Pradesh. The residents of these areas shall continue to retain their
customary rights as provided in Wazib-Ul-Urj of the record of rights.

By order,

Sd/-
(DEVESH KUMAR)
Pr. Secretary (UD).

Council, Rohru, District Shimla was notified in accordance with the provisions of sub-section
(1) of Section 5 of Himachal Pradesh Municipal Act, 1994 (State Act No. 13 of 1994) for inviting
objections from the inhabitant(s)/person(s) likely to be affected thereby, vide this Department
Notification No. UD-A(1)-5/2025, dated 07-08-2025 and published in Rajpatra (e-Gazette),
Himachal Pradesh on 11-08-2025;

AND WHEREAS, the objections received from the inhabitants of the local areas proposed to
be included in Municipal Council Rohru, District Shimla, within the prescribed time limit, during
the personal hearing, were duly considered and finally decided by the Competent Authority vide
order dated 10-03-2026 in accordance with law;

NOW, THEREFORE, the Governor, Himachal Pradesh, in exercise of the powers under sub-
section (3) of Section 5 of the Himachal Pradesh Municipal Act, 1994 ( State Act No. 13 of 1994),
is pleased to include the areas specified in THE SCHEDULE attached with this notification, in the
Municipal Council, Rohru, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh from the date of publication of this
notification in Rajpatra (e-Gazette), Himachal Pradesh.

The Governor, Himachal Pradesh in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4)
of Section 5 read with sub-section (1) of Section 80 of Act ibid, is further pleased to exempt the
land and buildings in the areas specified in THE SCHEDULE from payment of property tax
for a period of three years from the date of publication of this notification in the Rajpatra (e-
Gazette), Himachal Pradesh. The residents of these areas shall continue to retain their customary
rights as provided in Wazib-Ul-Urj of the record of rights.
By Order,

Sd/-
(DEVESH KUMAR),
Pr. Secretary (UD).

notification in the H.P. Rajpatra (e-Gazette) in the public interest.

By order,

R.D. NAZEEM, I.A.S. ,
